title: Oven Baked Middle Eastern Cookies Harees
description: A festive Middle Eastern dish featuring crisp cookies, this recipe is Whole30-friendly and perfect for special occasions. It combines floral flavors with a crunchy texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, coconut sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together rose water, orange blossom water, eggs, and melted coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Scoop tablespoon-sized balls of dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
To achieve the harees shape, use a ttukbaegi-earthenware-cook or a wok to mold the cookies while they are still warm.
Serve the cookies in the harees shape, garnished with additional dried rose petals if desired.
